risk_flags.description: The contract adds a new public function but does not explicitly include the required public-function docstring. This matters because the contribution policy requires at least a one-line docstring for every public function.

The verification promise is slightly weaker than the project rule: it names `pytest`, while the policy specifically requires `python -m pytest` with zero failures and zero warnings. The agent should confirm it will run the required command and check warnings.
risk_flags.span: The full existing test suite (`pytest`) passes with no regressions after the changes.

verdict.primary_risk: The main risk is that the contract does not explicitly commit to all contribution-policy requirements for the new public function and final test verification.
